text:
Type: sofa with left-side chaise longue
Use: seating, lounging, putting feet up; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, dark stained wooden legs and base
Colors: light warm grey, greige, dark brown
Shape: L-shaped corner form, wide boxy track arms, loose back and seat cushions, chaise on the left, low dark rectangular legs, substantial yet tidy
Feel: calm, soft, tailored, welcoming
Goes with: light or dark wood, white walls, linen and wool textiles; contemporary or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: NOCKEBY
product.type_ikea: Two-seat sofa w chaise longue left
product.description: You get extra soft comfort and support because the thick seat cushions have a core of pocket springs and a top of cut foam and polyester fibres.
